drifted.spec_text: If `spdk_mem_unregister` fails, the method returns the error without calling `cudaHostUnregister`.
drifted.actual: spdk_mem_unregister failure is kept as spdk_err (src/lib.rs:1223-1228); cudaHostUnregister always runs (:1231); a CUDA failure returns the CUDA error (:1232-1237, SPDK error dropped); otherwise the SPDK error is returned (:1239-1242). Reason in comment :1218-1222: avoid leaking the CUDA pin when SPDK became active after registration.

interface_docs.doc_text: Register existing host memory as CUDA-pinned and SPDK DMA-capable. Calls `cudaHostRegister` ... then `spdk_mem_register` ... (:786-790). # Errors: Returns an error if CUDA host registration or SPDK registration fails (:802). / Calls `spdk_mem_unregister` then `cudaHostUnregister` (:808-809). # Errors: Returns an error if unregistration fails (:813).
interface_docs.actual: SPDK step conditional on is_spdk_env_active() in both methods (9a79224a1, src/lib.rs:1179-1181, :1223). d45ab524d makes unregister call both steps whenever SPDK is active, even after an SPDK failure, so the 'spdk_mem_unregister then cudaHostUnregister' order is now always honoured; :802 and :813 aligned.
interface_docs.open_item: P-5 (from 2026-11-07, not approved, deferred); wording refreshed this run

observations: tests/host_memory_without_spdk.rs:35-39 now returns early (SKIP on stderr) when initialize fails; on a GPU-less runner the test passes without checking anything, and stderr is printed only on failure (:70-86). A green result is evidence for A-14 only on a GPU host.
No test covers the d45ab524d error path (SPDK unregister fails -> CUDA unregister still runs -> SPDK Err); needs real SPDK + GPU.

After the SPDK-failure Err the region is no longer CUDA-pinned; a retry would get a cudaHostUnregister error. In-tree callers ignore the result (components/dispatcher/src/lib.rs:2424, components/dispatcher-p2p/src/lib.rs:1735).
Carried over: allocate_pinned_dma_buffer -> src/dma.rs:259 spdk_mem_register unguarded; aligned with 001 FR-020, same crash class without SPDK; dispatcher-side check recommended.
